about_the_game:
The Enigma Cases: Bloodlines – Family Secrets

The forgotten story of a wealthy family resurfaces through a new murder case.
Bloodlines explores the dark side of human nature, where inheritance, loyalty, and betrayal intertwine.
As the investigation unfolds, every document, testimony, and DNA sample reveals another layer of truth buried in the family’s past.

Hidden Bonds of the Family

For generations, secrets have been locked away in letters, diaries, and archives.
Witnesses stay silent, evidence is missing, and family members no longer trust one another.
Between greed and guilt, players must determine who truly belongs to the bloodline.

Where Science Meets Intuition

Modern investigative methods lie at the core of this case.
Players use genetic analysis and DNA tracing to uncover hidden relationships and reconstruct the family tree.
AI-assisted forensic tools help revive forgotten traces and bring long-lost truths back to light.

Truth Beyond Blood

Some clues connect directly to characters from the main game.
Bloodlines opens a new door into the deeper history of The Enigma Cases universe.
Each discovery exposes one truth but conceals another.
Is loyalty defined by blood, or by the lies we choose to protect?

🔒 Requires the base game The Enigma Cases on Steam to play.

content_descriptors.notes:
Since our game is a detective game, there are different stories in each case.
For example, the cases focus on solving how the deceased people died, whether it was murder or suicide.

When we take the case and go to the scene where the victim died, we reach the adult content there.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX 4350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The past of a family is rewritten by the secrets it tried to bury. In the Bloodlines DLC, you’ll uncover hidden identities, inheritance conflicts, and DNA traces that challenge the true meaning of family.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hindi, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
